design: Deux duels partagés séparés, référence puis variante, chacun OpexAI slot 0 vs AAAHogEx slot 1

policy_comparison.protocol: C66.4 paired policies, separate shared-map duels versus same frozen AAAHogEx

decision_rule.primary_rule: first wins>=15/20 and exact two-sided sign-test p<0.05; then mean(variant-reference) >= min_useful_primary_delta
decision_rule.value_guard_rule: all 20 reference denominators must be positive; then ratio_of_means(company_value) percent change >= -value_guard_max_loss_pct
